title: chat/calendars clients cannot send metadata-02 filters
description: Per draft-ietf-jmap-metadata-02 §3.5 each opted-in type's Foo/query FilterCondition gains metadataExists / privateMetadataExists / metadata{TextContains,TextEquals} / privateMetadata{TextContains,TextEquals}. Per JMAP-ua37.4 the typed per-type FilterCondition structs carry no metadata fields; jmap-metadata-client's builders return serde_json::Value. mail/contacts/tasks/filenode/sharing clients take Option<serde_json::Value> filters and work. These take typed filters and cannot carry metadata conditions: jmap-chat-client (chat_query, message_query, space_query, custom_emoji_query, contact query + their queryChanges), jmap-calendars-client calendar_event_query / calendar_event_notification_query (+ queryChanges). Needs a decision: Value filter, typed metadata fields, or document as unsupported. Found during JMAP-ua37.6.
notes: 2026-10-19: fold into the typed client Filter<T> sweep (JMAP-1j9k.2 decision) in batch 3.
close_reason: Covered by 8827090e for calendars (all four methods) and chat *_query_changes via WithMetadata. Remaining chat *_query methods tracked in JMAP-a4gi (depends on JMAP-ops7.20). CI green at 88929342 (stable+beta 3516 passed).
